name: Carrion Defense Works Ballistic Face Shield BFS-2
product_name: Carrion Defense Works Ballistic Face Shield BFS-2
description: A transparent ballistic visor that provides NIJ Level IIIA facial protection while maintaining full visual clarity. The BFS-2 is constructed from layered polycarbonate and ceramic nano-fiber composite, capable of stopping handgun rounds and fragmentary projectiles while being optically clear enough for precision shooting. The visor mounts to standard helmet rails and features an integrated HUD projection layer compatible with most tactical display systems. Anti-fog, anti-scratch, and anti-glare coatings are standard. The visor's lower edge extends to the chin, providing protection that conventional eyewear helmets miss.

specifications.ballistic rating: NIJ Level IIIA — stops handgun rounds

story_hooks: A BFS-2 stopped a round that would have been fatal, but the visor's HUD layer recorded the muzzle flash position and the shooter's location was transmitted to response teams before they could relocate.
Modified BFS-2 visors with built-in facial recognition overlay have appeared — the wearer sees real-time identity information for every face they look at, sourced from hacked databases.

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek, wraparound transparent visor extending from forehead to chin with a subtle curve that follows facial contours. The shield presents an almost frameless appearance with only thin mounting brackets visible at the sides. A faint iridescent shimmer plays across the surface, hinting at the layered composite construction beneath the crystal-clear exterior.
physical_description.dimensions: Approximately 25cm wide × 18cm tall × 3cm deep; fits standard helmet rail mounts
physical_description.weight_description: 0.8kg — lightweight enough for extended wear, noticeable but not burdensome when mounted
physical_description.primary_material: Polycarbonate and ceramic nano-fiber composite laminate with integrated projection layer
physical_description.finish: Optically polished to 97% clarity with a hard-coat anti-glare treatment; subtle holographic depth visible when light hits edges
physical_description.color_scheme: Crystal clear with faint amber-tinted edges where light refracts through composite layers; mounting hardware in gunmetal gray with black polymer reinforcement
physical_description.interface_elements: Minimalist side-mounted rail connectors; small pressure-sensitive activation points at temple areas; thin edge bezel with embedded micro-sensors; no visible buttons or controls — all interface passive
distinctive_features: Extended chin protection — lower edge curves below natural jaw line
Integrated HUD projection layer visible as faint grid pattern when powered
Micro-etched anti-fog coating creates subtle texture across inner surface
Iridescent rainbow fringing at extreme angles reveals ceramic nano-fiber sandwich construction
Rail-mount system shows precision engineering with quick-detach mechanism
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: Subtle 'CARRION DEFENSE WORKS' engraving on right temple mount; NIJ LEVEL IIIA stamp in tiny text at lower right edge; serial number laser-etched into left mounting bracket
physical_description.condition_typical: Usually mounted to combat helmet or tactical headgear; interior may show condensation on lower edge during active use despite anti-fog coating; HUD layer glows faintly with tactical data overlay when powered
